Developed dynamic web applications, architected database schemas, and built robust back-end APIs and responsive front-end interfaces.
Supervised IT operations, system reliability, infrastructure deployments, and supported enterprise software solutions across multi-site client deployments.
Designed and maintained enterprise web applications and business logic modules using Java and JavaServer Pages (JSP), integrating with relational databases.
Networking analysis, technical training, hardware & software troubleshooting, Linux system administration, electrical engineering maintenance, and general affairs.
